title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 15
subtitle: Before and After
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 15: Before and After (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, even though we both love speed walking, could we slow down a bit?
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，虽然我们都爱竞走，能不能慢一点？

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: No way! I think because I’m walking with you, I’m walking faster.
dialogue.zh: 不行！我觉得因为跟你一起走，我走得更快了。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Come on, Penelope. Let's take a break. We've been speed walking since 8 a.m.! You're so competitive! You even wore your medals!
dialogue.zh: 拜托，佩内洛普。休息一下吧。我们从早上 8 点就在竞走了！你好好胜！你还戴着奖牌！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: You brought your trophies! You’re out of shape. When we were little girls, we could speed walk all day! (pulls ahead)
dialogue.zh: 你还带了奖杯！你身体不行了。我们还是小女孩的时候，可以竞走一整天！（抢先走）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: (chases her) Hey, wait for me! Hey, you know the speed walking rules! If both feet leave the ground, it’s running! You ran!
dialogue.zh: （追她）嘿，等等我！嘿，你知道竞走规则！如果双脚都离地，那就是跑步！你跑了！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna and Penelope are doing something they both love - speed walking! They are also using adverb clauses. Adverb clauses tell us when, why, how, where and under what conditions. For example, “since 8 a.m.” tells us when. Adverb clauses are dependent clauses and need an independent clause to make a complete sentence. Words like before, after, when, because, since, if and even though can signal an adverb clause. Keep watching for more adverb clauses!
dialogue.zh: 安娜和佩内洛普在做她们都喜欢的事——竞走！她们也在用状语从句。状语从句告诉我们何时、为何、怎样、何处以及在什么条件下。比如 “since 8 a.m.” 告诉我们时间。状语从句是从属从句，需要一个独立从句才能构成完整句子。before、after、when、because、since、if 和 even though 这类词可以提示状语从句。继续看，找更多状语从句！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Whew! That was great!
dialogue.zh: 呼！太棒了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: (Anna catches up) Wow, Penelope, you’re still really fast! Since I’ve been working in an office, my speed walking has been much slower.
dialogue.zh: （安娜追上）哇，佩内洛普，你还是很快！自从我在办公室工作以来，我的竞走慢多了。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: You are slower, Anna. Maybe you should hire a personal trainer.
dialogue.zh: 你是慢了，安娜。也许你该请个私人教练。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That will be great. As long as the trainer understands speed walking.
dialogue.zh: 那很好。只要教练懂竞走就行。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: (hands her a business card) Try this company. After you fill out an online application, they will match you to the perfect trainer.
dialogue.zh: （递给她一张名片）试试这家公司。你填完网上申请后，他们会给你匹配最合适的教练。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: As soon as I get home tonight, I’ll do it! Thanks.
dialogue.zh: 今晚我一到家就填！谢谢。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Are you my trainer?
dialogue.zh: 你是我的教练吗？

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: If you’re Anna, then I’m your trainer -- Alaskan Albert. Because I’m from Alaskan wilderness, I’m skilled in all outdoor activities of the wild.
dialogue.zh: 如果你是安娜，那我就是你的教练——阿拉斯加的艾伯特。因为我来自阿拉斯加荒野，我擅长所有野外户外活动。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s great but what about speed walking?
dialogue.zh: 那很好，可竞走呢？

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Speed walking? That's funny! Since I’ve been living in the city, I’ve combined wilderness training with a city workout. I call it “Call of the Wild Parkour!” (He howls like a wolf.)
dialogue.zh: 竞走？真好笑！自从我住在城里，我就把荒野训练和城市锻炼结合起来。我叫它“野性的呼唤跑酷！”（他像狼一样嚎叫。）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay … but seriously, when do we speed walk?
dialogue.zh: 好吧……可说真的，我们什么时候竞走？

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Your application did not say how funny you are!
dialogue.zh: 你的申请没说你这么幽默！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. But it did say that I'm a speed walker! Did you read it? Forget it. We'll have to cancel.
dialogue.zh: 没有。可它写了我是竞走者！你读了吗？算了。我们得取消。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Why?
dialogue.zh: 为什么？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: We can't train today because it's too cold and too windy.
dialogue.zh: 今天不能训练，因为太冷也太刮风。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: No way! No pain, no gain! When you exercise in really cold weather, you feel alive!
dialogue.zh: 不行！没有痛苦就没有收获！在很冷的天气里锻炼，你会觉得自己活着！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Really? Because right now I just feel cold.
dialogue.zh: 真的吗？因为我现在只觉得冷。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: You're so funny. But seriously, after our training, you will be ready for any extreme physical challenge. Let's get started!
dialogue.zh: 你真有趣。可说真的，训练之后，你就能应对任何极限体能挑战。开始吧！

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Anna, even though you’re trying really hard, you’re really bad at Call of the Wild Parkour. (he howls)
dialogue.zh: 安娜，虽然你很努力，可你的“野性的呼唤跑酷”真的很差。（他嚎叫）

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I'm bad at Call of the Wild Parkour because I don’t want to do Call of the Wild Parkour! (she howls) I am a speed walker. It’s what I do. It’s part of who I am.
dialogue.zh: 我跑酷差，是因为我不想做“野性的呼唤跑酷”！（她嚎叫）我是竞走者。这就是我做的事。这是我的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Why didn’t you say something?
dialogue.zh: 你为什么不说？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I did. Several times! You thought I was joking.
dialogue.zh: 我说了。说了好几次！你以为我在开玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Now I understand. Anna, I can help you. If you follow my advice, I'll put the speed back in your speed walk.
dialogue.zh: 现在我明白了。安娜，我能帮你。如果你听我的建议，我会把速度还给你的竞走。

dialogue.speaker: Alaskan Albert
dialogue.en: Go, Anna, go!
dialogue.zh: 加油，安娜，加油！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: For more about adverb clauses, visit our website!
dialogue.zh: 想了解更多状语从句，请访问我们的网站！

quiz.prompt: What activity do Anna and Penelope both love?
What does Alaskan Albert call his workout?
What does Anna say she is?
